places.normalized: Brewery Lane, the town where Satis House stands (unnamed in the novel, often identified with Rochester, Kent)
places.quote: got behind one of the gates in the brewery-lane
places.note: Unnamed town; the lane is not in London. Identification with Rochester is a scholarly inference, not stated in the passage.

places.quote: as many hands high, according to scale, as a big-boned Irish hunter
places.note: Adjective used for a horse breed; included as a passing place-reference.
